placeholder: Ask a question about your documents…
emptyBody: Every answer is built only from the documents in this build, and shows which one it came from. If they don't contain the answer, it says so instead of guessing.
instantHint: These were prepared in advance and come back in about a second, with no model call.
slowHint: The model runs on this machine, so this can take a moment. It is working, not stuck.
sourcesHint: Every answer is grounded in these passages.
noSources: No source in your documents matched this question.
offline: The assistant is not responding. It may still be starting up — wait a moment and try again.
answersLanguageNote: The interface language changes this page only. Answers come back in the language your documents are written in — they are never machine-translated.
keyBody: This assistant is shared on your network, so it asks for the access key from your configuration file. You only need to enter it once on this computer.
keyError: That key was not accepted. It is the value of api_key in your configuration file.
postureLocal: Local — the model runs on this machine; your documents never leave it.
postureOnPremises: On your network — the model runs on your own hardware ({detail}); your documents never leave your building.
postureThirdParty: Third-party — documents are sent to {detail} with your own API key, as you asked for.
